body: Core documents.getVersioned/update (revision-checked, atomic, unchanged saves write nothing, new links must exist, new duplicates rejected, existing duplicates/dangling links kept until removed explicitly). HTTP: POST /api/documents/:kind, PATCH /api/documents/:kind/:id with expectedRevision (409 CONFLICT, 400 validation), GET returns revision. UI: shared editor for create/edit with Write/Preview, link picker from existing tickets/documents, duplicate badges with per-item removal, conflict message keeps the draft with explicit reload, two-step discard and beforeunload guard; new documents open in the reader. Verified end-to-end in Chromium.
author: claude
